subject: Lumina Health pilot — onboarding checklist + PO flexibility
messages:
From: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@luminahealth.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@luminahealth.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Lumina Health pilot — onboarding checklist + PO flexibility

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team was impressed with the latency and the model routing options. We’re planning a 60-day pilot (limited to one internal product team) and expect spend to be modest (~$3.5k) initially.

A couple of procurement questions before we kick off:
- Can Redwood accept invoices without a PO for the initial pilot period? Our internal policy typically requires a PO, but procurement is willing to be flexible for short pilots if we provide a documented exception and evidence.
- What vendor onboarding documents do you require (W-9, SOC 2, vendor intake form, contract/SOW)?

If you prefer, I can route paperwork from our side — otherwise please send the intake form and any evidence checklist and we’ll return what you need.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Gupta
Head of Platform Integrations | Lumina Health

Subject: Re: Lumina Health pilot — onboarding checklist + PO flexibility

Hi Sanjay — great to hear the demo resonated.

We can make the initial pilot work with invoice routing (no PO) on a temporary basis, but procurement + finance will want a clear exception window and the standard intake documents. Attached are: 
- vendor_intake_form.pdf (please complete and return)
- onboarding_checklist.xlsx (lists minimum evidence: W-9, primary contact, bank remit info, SOC2 report or ISO attestation)

Next steps I recommend:
1) Sanjay completes the intake form and returns with W-9 and (if available) the most recent SOC2 report
2) I’ll open a temporary exception request with procurement (cc’d: Marissa) and finance once we have the intake packet
3) Procurement will review and set a time-bound exception (we typically do 60–90 days) and confirm any spend threshold that forces PO creation mid-pilot

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in to confirm the exception process and any additional gating items (insurance, PII handling).

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@luminahealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumina Health pilot — onboarding checklist + PO flexibility

Hi team — thanks Aisha and Sanjay. Quick procurement read on this:

We can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for the pilot with the following conditions:
- Exception window: 90 days from the pilot start date;
- Spend threshold: if cumulative spend reaches $10,000 during the window we require a PO to be raised for the remaining term;
- Required evidence: completed vendor_intake_form.pdf, W-9, proof of company insurance (if vendor provides services on our environment), and SOC2 report or ISO attestation when available;
- Data handling: if Lumina stores any Redwood customer data we need the data flow diagram + DPA signed (we’ll prepare a standard DPA).

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0–3: Lumina returns intake + W-9 + SOC2 (if available)
- Day 3–7: Procurement review and temporary exception approval document (we’ll produce temp_exception_approval.docx)
- Day 7: Pilot kickoff

Sanjay — please confirm you can return the intake + W-9 this week. If anything on the list is a blocker let us know and we can be flexible on the SOC2 timing (but need the intake + W-9 and remediation notes).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference

Agree with Marissa — finance is comfortable with a 90-day invoice-only exception conditional on the items below: 
- Completed intake and W-9 on file before first invoice;
- Exception documented in our system with a clear owner and end date;
- Budget code provided by Lumina or the Redwood AE (we’ll need it to route invoices);
- If spend exceeds $10k we will require a PO for the remainder of the engagement (we’ll notify Lumina and pull the invoices into the PO retrospectively where possible).

Sanjay — can you confirm the billing contact and remit-to details for Lumina so we can add them to the intake form? Also note that payment terms default to Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated.

Thanks,
